{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to only customers who converted
converted_customers = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Filter out missing age data (age == -1)
valid_converted_customers = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute the mean age
mean_age = valid_converted_customers['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding age == -1): {mean_age}")"}
